four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear, and the failure matches a missing-dependency signature. Closest reference: DiCarlo-style MANIFOLD UNTANGLING (evidence/literature/targeted_review_perceptual_manifold_adaptors/entries/2026-06-12_arc_087_ventral_stream_manifold_untangling_dicarlo2012, and targeted_review_sd_015/entries/2026-04-02_sd_015_object_untangling_dicarlo2007). Untangling is the exact biological statement of H-C: information can be fully PRESENT in a population code and still be unusable by a simple downstream readout until a cascade of transforms has flattened and separated the behaviourally relevant manifolds. The reference mechanism's dependency is an objective and a pathway whose JOB is that reshaping; REE's z_world is trained for sensory prediction/reconstruction (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive plus the SD-018 auxiliary field head), an objective with no pressure to untangle the ACTION-relevant variable, and there is no separate action-formatted (dorsal-analogue) stream for the actor to read. Note the direction: in this environment the RAW field is ALREADY untangled for this task -- a 2x128 MLP reaches 0.979 on it, exactly as the SD-015 DiCarlo entry's own caveat predicts -- so the encoder is not being asked to untangle a hard manifold; it is discarding or tangling an easy one.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1002 (2026-09-05, diagnostic, claim-free) is the registered live_gate for hypothesis-space question `zworld_actor_adequacy_locus`. A capacity-matched supervised adapter (x734.PPOPolicyNet, 21381 action-path parameters, identical to V3-EXQ-978's reader) was behaviour-cloned on the local_view_greedy oracle's own visited states with credit assignment removed entirely. From the RAW 25-dim resource_field_view it reproduces the oracle at 0.9846/0.9796/0.9730 held-out. From V3-EXQ-978's FROZEN z_world it reaches 0.6695/0.6735/0.6478 -- 0/3 seeds against a bar of 0.80 -- and it does NOT beat its own paired untrained-projection control (0.6876/0.6817/0.6947) on any seed (margins -0.018/-0.008/-0.047). Every readiness gate is green. H-B (consumer-learning) is therefore ELIMINATED: with the learning problem removed, the mapping still does not come out of the latent, and H-C (geometry mismatch) is CONFIRMED at its registered gate. What the run does NOT establish is that the deficit belongs to THIS latent's LEARNED geometry: its only 32-dimensional comparator is an untrained random compression of the SAME 250-dim world_state input (the 25-dim field is 10% of it), that comparator ties with -- in fact slightly beats -- the verdict arm, and no run to date carries a 32-dim reference of that input known to be able to clear the bar. So the confirmed H-C leg's 'learned geometry' gloss and a 250 -> 32 channel-INPUT bound that no rotation could fix remain confounded; the owed information-preserving rotation corroborator and a 32-dim projection of the full world_state are the two parallel tests, and a flat result on the former WEAKENS the confirmed leg.

live_hypotheses: H-C-geometry-mismatch (pre-registered; CONFIRMED 2026-09-05 at its registered live_gate, on a CAVEATED basis, met_elimination_bar false): the information is present and linearly decodable (V3-EXQ-978: r2 0.71 sense path, 0.86 encoder path) but z_world's geometry does not make the relationships action selection needs accessible. The gate is verbatim 'CANNOT reproduce -> H-C' and the adapter could not reproduce, on a fully green instrument. The caveat is that the untrained comparator TIES with the verdict arm (0.664 vs 0.688), so the 'THIS latent's LEARNED geometry' gloss is not established; the owed rotation corroborator is the TEST of this leg and a flat result there weakens it.

H-E-channel-input-capacity (NEW, labelled fan-out, ALIVE): the deficit is a channel-INPUT bottleneck property of the 250 -> 32 encoding rather than a rotation-fixable arrangement of a particular latent. The encoder reads the FULL 250-dim world_state (the 25-dim resource_field_view is 10% of it), so zworld_untrained is a random NONLINEAR compression of 250 dims into 32 and its failure at 0.688 is evidence about the input bottleneck, not about '32 dimensions of this observation'. If H-E holds, H-C's learned-geometry gloss is unsupportable and the owed rotation corroborator is a foregone null.

H-D-warmup-not-the-locus (labelled fan-out on a GIT WITNESS; CONFIRMED 2026-09-05, necessary-not-sufficient): retained here for completeness -- it is resolved, not live. The SD-018/P0a warmup does not account for the ~0.30 deficit; on the pre-registered standardised instrument the warmed latent is consistently slightly WORSE than an untrained projection on fittability and no better held-out.

suggested_probes.leg: PARALLEL LEG 1 of 2 (not ordered, not conditional)
suggested_probes.sketch: THE CHANNEL-INPUT CONTROL. Add a comparator to this exact design: a 32-dimensional random-Gaussian and/or PCA-32 projection of the FULL 250-dim world_state -- the encoder's ACTUAL input, optionally plus body_state to mirror the topdown term -- fitted on the training split only, read by the SAME x734.PPOPolicyNet adapter, on the SAME banked V3-EXQ-1002 dataset, with the SAME per-dimension standardiser. Declared null: this 250 -> 32 projection also fails to clear the 0.80 bar. CLEARS -> H-E eliminated; an optimal LINEAR 250 -> 32 compression preserves what the task needs, so the deficit is specific to what the REE encoder channel does to the observation and H-C's learned-geometry gloss survives. DOES NOT CLEAR -> H-E confirmed; the deficit is a channel-INPUT bound no rotation of z_world can fix, H-C's confirmed leg is WEAKENED to its narrow gate sense, and the route is instrument/interface redesign rather than a geometry build. NOTE, as a sanity anchor and NOT a gate: a 32-dim projection of the 25-dim resource_field_view ALONE is expected to clear trivially -- any injective linear map R^25 -> R^32 composed with the adapter's Linear(32,128) spans exactly the Linear(25,128) function class, so its declared null is unrealisable and it is a re-basis of the positive control rather than a capacity test. That is why the earlier draft's 25-dim-field version of this leg is DROPPED. Cost: no ree_core change, no new warmup family, no contract-gate exposure.

suggested_probes.leg: PARALLEL LEG 2 of 2 (not ordered, not conditional)
suggested_probes.sketch: THE ORIGINALLY-OWED H-C CORROBORATOR, run in PARALLEL with leg 1 rather than conditional on it. Apply a transformation that approximately preserves the recoverable information in the frozen z_world while rotating/reweighting the geometry (whitening, per-dimension reweighting toward decision-relevant directions, or a train-split-fitted supervised linear re-basis) and re-run the identical adapter on the identical banked dataset and standardiser. Declared null: agreement is flat under an information-preserving, separability-improving re-basis. This is the TEST of the now-confirmed H-C leg: a flat result WEAKENS it (registry states are not terminal, and met_elimination_bar false already records that the corroborator is owed), a lift CORROBORATES it. It is run in parallel because the previous draft's ordering argument depended on the dropped 25-dim-field leg being informative; with leg 1 respecified to the 250-dim input, neither leg's outcome is a foregone conclusion and neither can make the other unnecessary in advance. Cost: same banked dataset and adapter, no new warmup family.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1. A PARALLEL two-leg portfolio, deliberately NOT an ordered chain (user decision at the Step 8 gate, 2026-09-05). The earlier draft made leg 2 conditional on leg 1 clearing; the cross-model red-team pass showed that ordering rested on a leg-1 specification (a 32-dim projection of the 25-dim FIELD) whose declared null is unrealisable by construction, which made the 'portfolio' a sequential chain with a decorative first step -- the single-letter shape GOV-FANOUT-1 exists to prevent. With leg 1 respecified to the encoder's ACTUAL 250-dim input, both legs carry realisable declared nulls, both run on V3-EXQ-1002's banked dataset and adapter, and both bear on the confirmed H-C leg from different directions. The two legs sit in DIFFERENT axis families (instrumentation vs representation). Leg 2 sits in `representation`, the family that already holds the ELIMINATED H-B and the CONFIRMED H-C -- but it adds NO new leg to the registry: it is the owed corroborator OF the confirmed H-C leg, i.e. a test of an existing leg rather than a fresh rival re-entering a swept family, so it is not circling. Only H-D (`constitution`) and H-E (`instrumentation`) are new legs, and neither family previously carried a leg on this question. Both are recorded in hypothesis_space_ledger_pending below; neither is queued by this session. A lettered V3-EXQ-1002b power-bump remains REFUSED.

learning_extracted: H-B IS ELIMINATED, and this is the run's load-bearing, uncontested result. The frozen-latent reader had failed twice before (V3-EXQ-948 ppo_ree_latent 0.5 res/ep, V3-EXQ-978 OFF arm 0.267, both 0/3 against a 1.0 floor) and both failures were confounded with RL credit assignment. Removing credit assignment entirely -- supervised cross-entropy on the oracle's action at every visited state, at the consumer's exact capacity, on a green instrument -- does not recover the mapping. The deficit is on the representation side of the interface, not in the consumer's learning.

THE VERDICT ARM AND ITS UNTRAINED CONTROL ARE NOT SEPARATED IN THE DIRECTION THE GRID EXPECTS, and the pre-registered standardised instrument says the warmed latent is slightly WORSE. zworld_off is at or below zworld_untrained on every seed of the held-out split (-0.018/-0.008/-0.047, mean -0.024, 2.3x the pooled within-arm seed SD), the training split (0.766/0.760/0.752 vs 0.828/0.828/0.821, mean -0.067 at 11.7x), the final standardised CE (+0.145/+0.150/+0.157, 17.7x, off worse) and the random-driven distribution (0.572/0.602/0.611 vs 0.613/0.636/0.631); turn states are 2/3. The reported UNSTANDARDISED readout reverses the sign (off 0.534/0.542/0.553 vs untrained 0.494/0.467/0.538) but carries no sign: it sits BELOW the trivial repeat-previous-action baseline (0.566/0.580/0.572) on 3/3 seeds on BOTH z arms with CE 1.05-1.17 against ln 5 = 1.609, i.e. that adapter did not converge on either arm, and the driver PRE-REGISTERS the standardised primary as the number that answers the question when the two diverge. So the honest statement is 'no better than, and on the primary instrument consistently slightly worse than, a random projection of the same input' -- by an amount (0.02 held-out, 0.07 train) an order of magnitude smaller than the ~0.30 deficit to the raw field, which is why the warmup is not the LOCUS of the deficit. The one preprocessing-invariant asymmetry points the same way: the warmup roughly HALVES the participation ratio (4.57/4.22/5.67 vs 7.49/10.31/10.01, 0.53x) while buying no action-relevant agreement.

RECORDED AND WITHDRAWN -- 'the H-C attribution conjunct is inverted relative to its own stated purpose'. The draft argued that because C_untrained_control_below_bar fires when the untrained 32-dim projection FAILS, it supplies the '32 dimensions of anything cannot do it' reading's evidence rather than excluding it, and used that argument to hold H-C `alive` against its own pre-registered gate. WITHDRAWN at the Step 8 gate after the cross-model red-team pass, and recorded rather than deleted. Two grounds: (1) the conjunct's DOCUMENTED purpose, stated in three places (the driver's ARMS section, the manifest's interpretation.question, and the C_verdict_arm_beats_untrained_control description), is ATTRIBUTION TO THE WARMUP -- 'whether any actionability found is creditable to SD-018's warmup' -- plus a guard against a spurious H-C via a collapsed comparator, and for THAT purpose the conjunct's sign is correct; (2) the single phrase 'rather than to 32 dimensions of anything cannot do it' is loose English and was incoherent as written -- 32 > 25 field dims, and the encoder's actual input is 250 dims, not 25 -- so it is a WORDING DEFECT IN THE DRIVER, not a licence to reopen a pre-registered gate. What survives of the objection is substantive and is recorded where the registry puts doubt: in H-C's caveated resolution basis, and in the two new legs. General lesson retained: for each attribution criterion, require a stated POSITIVE case -- 'here is the comparator that COULD have cleared, and it did' -- not only a negative one; and state the criterion's purpose in the criterion, so a loose gloss cannot later be read as the specification.

THE ENVIRONMENT AND THE INSTRUMENT ARE BOTH EXONERATED, which is what makes the null informative. The oracle clears the competence floor from the SAME 5x5 view the adapter reads (45.75/49.70/48.70 vs 1.0), closing the V3-EXQ-732a privileged-oracle confound; the identical adapter reaches 0.973-0.985 on the raw field; the finding replicates on a random-driven state distribution and on the shortcut-free turn-state subset. The gap being explained is raw-25-dim 0.979 versus 0.66-0.69 for any 32-dim compression of the 250-dim world_state, on identical steps.

BIOLOGICAL READ: this is a missing-prerequisite signature, not a falsification. DiCarlo-style untangling (two entries in evidence/literature) says a population code can carry information a simple readout cannot use until a cascade whose JOB is reshaping has separated the behaviourally relevant manifolds. REE's z_world is trained for sensory prediction/reconstruction plus an auxiliary field head -- objectives with no pressure to untangle the ACTION-relevant variable -- and there is no separate action-formatted (dorsal-analogue) stream for an actor to read. Note the inversion that makes this cheap to act on: in this environment the raw field is ALREADY untangled for the task (the SD-015 DiCarlo entry predicted exactly this: a 2-layer MLP suffices on resource_field_view), so the encoder is not failing a hard untangling problem -- it is tangling or discarding an easy one.

RECORDING: the manifest is complete against the Experimental Recording Standard always-core (validate_recording.py OK -- recording_schema rec/v1, substrate_hash, machine, machine_class, elapsed_seconds, config, explicit seeds), and its per-cell secondaries (train-split agreement, unstandardised agreement, turn-state agreement, random-state agreement, participation ratio, CE loss, death rate) are what made the reframing above possible from the artifact alone with no re-run. This is the positive case for the standard: a driver that recorded generously turned a boolean verdict into a graded, auditable finding at zero extra compute.

PROCESS: a pre-registered boolean grid can be evaluated perfectly and still mis-name its own cell. The grid's arithmetic, its self-tests, its three readiness gates and its three red-team passes were all working; what escaped them is that one criterion's ENGLISH claim about what it establishes does not follow from the condition it tests. The cheap general guard is to require, for each attribution criterion, a stated positive case -- 'here is the comparator that COULD have cleared, and it did' -- rather than only a negative one.

PREMISE CHECK -- READ WHAT THE ENCODER ACTUALLY EATS. The draft's whole missing-control design, and its argument for holding H-C open, rested on treating z_world as a 32-dim encoding of the 25-dim resource_field_view. It is not: causal_grid_world.py sets world_obs_dim = 250 under use_proxy_fields=True (local_view 175 + contamination 25 + hazard_field 25 + resource_field 25, with resource_field_view = world_state[225:250]), and the driver passes the whole 250-dim world_state to agent.sense. On the wrong premise the proposed control was vacuous by construction -- any injective linear map R^25 -> R^32 composed with the adapter's Linear(32,128) spans exactly the Linear(25,128) function class, so the positive control's own 0.973-0.985 function is representable and the declared null could only fire through an optimisation artefact. hypothesis_space_ledger_pending.synthesis: As of V3-EXQ-1002 the actor-adequacy deficit is located on the REPRESENTATION side of the observation-to-action interface, and not in the consumer. With credit assignment removed entirely and the reader held at the consumer's exact capacity, the local_view_greedy oracle's policy is recoverable from the raw 25-dim observation at 0.979 held-out agreement and from the frozen 32-dim z_world at 0.664 -- a gap of ~0.31 on identical steps, replicated on a random-driven state distribution and on a shortcut-free turn-state subset. H-B (consumer learning) is ELIMINATED and H-C (geometry mismatch) is CONFIRMED at its registered gate. Two things the run does not settle are recorded rather than glossed. First, the deficit is not what the SD-018/P0a warmup wrote: on the pre-registered standardised instrument the warmed latent is no better than, and consistently slightly worse than, an untrained projection of the same input (H-D, confirmed) -- by an amount an order of magnitude smaller than the deficit itself. Second, the encoder's actual input is the full 250-dim world_state, of which the 25-dim field is 10%, so the run's only 32-dim comparator is itself a compression of that input and its failure is equally consistent with a 250 -> 32 channel-INPUT bound (H-E, alive) that no rotation of z_world could fix; H-C's confirmed label therefore carries a caveated basis and an owed corroborator. A parallel two-leg portfolio on the banked dataset separates them: a 32-dim projection of the full world_state, and an information-preserving re-basis of the frozen latent. Biologically the shape is a missing prerequisite rather than a falsification: DiCarlo-style untangling says a code can carry information a simple readout cannot use until a cascade whose job is reshaping has separated the behaviourally relevant manifolds, and z_world is trained for sensory prediction with no pressure to untangle the action-relevant variable and no separate action-formatted stream for an actor to read.
